title: Medical
subtitle: Care, stabilization, and crew support
intro: Medical looks after the health and operational readiness of the crew whenever missions become risky, stressful, or unpredictable. On the Cori, it combines professional care with responsibility, composure, and attention to the human side of life aboard ship.
focusItems: Support during physically or psychologically demanding missions
missionExamples: Post-incident care after combat, accidents, or anomalies
Support during quarantine or high-stress situations
cultureText: Medical aboard the Cori is built on competence, care, and trust. Anyone who remains calm, takes responsibility, and remembers that every mission affects real people will belong here.
